Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support further upside.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and precious metal demand coupled with tight physical markets.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and robust electrification demand underpin prices.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build-outs.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new project ramp-ups offsets EV demand growth.

Nickel.note: Persistent surplus driven by continuous Indonesian NPI and MHP supply growth.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter treatment charge squeezes limit refined supply.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing structural weakness in Chinese property construction dampens steel demand.

Coal.note: Balanced market with offsetting thermal weakness and met coal resilience.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks balanced by sluggish near-term electric vehicle motor demand.

Manganese.note: Stable steel production requirements offset by ample South African and Gabonese supply.

PGM.note: Substitution of platinum for palladium in auto catalysts and weak hydrogen adoption.

Potash.note: Normalizing global agricultural application rates balance steady baseline fertilizer demand.

Aluminum.note: Smelter curtailments in China and robust solar and auto lightweighting demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Broad commodity basket provides a natural hedge against idiosyncratic single-metal risks.
